repos.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: GitHubDaily 是一个持续更新的开源项目推荐仓库，累计分享超万个高质量 GitHub 项目，覆盖 AI 工具、学习教程、开发工具等类别，帮助开发者快速发现优质资源、掌握技术趋势、提升编程技能。
repos.summary_en: GitHubDaily is a curated list of cool, interesting GitHub projects, sharing over 10,000 high-quality resources across AI tools, tutorials, and dev utilities to help developers discover top projects, track tech trends, and improve coding skills.

repos.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.
repos.summary_zh: 1Panel是一款现代化开源Linux服务器面板及轻量级AI管理平台。通过直观Web界面提供一站式运维，深度融合AI网关与智能体管理，简化主机与容器管理，助力网站和AI应用快速部署，显著降低运维门槛。
repos.summary_en: 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform loved by a global community of over 2.5 million users. Through an intuitive web interface, it provides comprehensive, one-stop server operations, seamlessly integrating AI gateway, agent, and model management. It streamlines host monitoring, container orchestration, database management, curated app store deployments, and rapid website setup, significantly lowering the technical barrier for efficient server and AI application administration.

repos.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署
repos.summary_zh: IPTV-API是一款功能全面的IPTV直播源自动化采集与管理工具，支持多源聚合、智能校验测速及自定义频道，输出M3U、TXT及API，支持CLI、GUI和Docker多端部署。
repos.summary_en: IPTV-API is a comprehensive automated tool for IPTV live stream collection, validation, and speed testing. It aggregates sources, filters high-quality channels, and outputs customized playlists in M3U, TXT, or API formats. With support for IPv4/IPv6, Docker, CLI, and GUI, it provides a robust solution for seamless live TV playback.

repos.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader是抖音/TikTok下载与数据采集工具，支持高清视频、图集、直播流下载，具备批量采集、多账号管理、数据持久化及Web UI交互。基于Python开发，支持Docker部署，提供代理、多线程、断点续传等功能，适用于内容存档与数据分析。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a TikTok/Douyin downloading and data collection tool, supporting HD videos, image albums, and live stream capture. It features batch collection, multi-account management, data persistence, and Web UI interaction. Built with Python and Docker, it offers proxy support, multi-threading, and resumable downloads for content archiving and data analysis.

repos.description: A feature-rich weather app with good visualizations and more than 50 sources.
repos.summary_zh: Breezy Weather 是一款功能丰富、开源免费的 Android 天气应用，采用 Kotlin 和 Jetpack Compose 开发，遵循 Material 3 设计规范。它支持超过 50 个天气源，提供预报、空气质量、花粉和警报等精美数据可视化，是高效实用的天气工具。
repos.summary_en: Breezy Weather is a feature-rich, free, and open-source Android weather app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Featuring Material 3 design, it supports over 50 weather sources and provides stunning visualizations for forecasts, air quality, and alerts.

repos.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.
repos.summary_zh: MediaGo是一款跨平台视频下载工具，内置流量嗅探技术，可自动识别并抓取m3u8/HLS流，支持Bilibili、YouTube等千余站点。提供桌面应用、Docker部署及浏览器扩展，集成AI助手技能，通过HTTP API实现自动化下载与格式转换，无需复杂配置，一键获取高清视频。
repos.summary_en: MediaGo is a cross-platform video downloader with built-in sniffing to automatically detect and grab m3u8/HLS streams, supporting Bilibili, YouTube, and over a thousand sites. It offers desktop app, Docker deployment, and browser extension, with AI assistant integration and HTTP API for automated downloading and format conversion, no complex setup required.

repos.description: 小白自建代理神器！ArgoSBX一键无交互小钢炮脚本💣：Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核自动搭配；支持VPS、Docker、容器多环境部署；套CDN的5大方案+套WARP的15种组合；已支持协议：Naiveproxy、AnyTLS、Any-reality、Vless-xhttp-reality-vision-enc、Vless-tcp-reality-vision、Vless-xhttp-vision-enc、Vless-ws-vision-enc、Shadowsocks-2022、Hysteria2、Tuic、Socks5、Vmess-ws、Argo临时/固定隧道
repos.summary_zh: Argosbx是一键无交互代理搭建脚本，集成Sing-box、Xray与Argo三内核，支持VPS与Docker多环境部署。内置15种WARP出站组合与5大CDN方案，无需域名即可快速搭建高性能多协议科学上网节点。
repos.summary_en: Argosbx is a lightweight, one-click script integrating Sing-box, Xray, and Cloudflare Argo for proxy deployment. Supporting VPS and Docker, it simplifies setup with zero interaction, offering 15 WARP combinations, 5 CDN schemes, and robust multi-protocol support without requiring a domain.

repos.description: Open-Box 一体化透明代理：OpenWrt / Debian / Ubuntu / Docker；自有程序闭源，第三方组件遵守原许可。
repos.summary_zh: Open-Box 是一体化透明代理，支持 OpenWrt/Debian/Ubuntu/Docker 路由器端及多平台客户端。图形化面板无需配置文件即可管理订阅、分流与防火墙，集成 sing-box 内核与完整 Geo 数据，实现规则调试、链式代理与 DNS 直连，适用于局域网科学上网与流量优化。
repos.summary_en: Open-Box is an all-in-one transparent proxy solution with router support for OpenWrt, Debian, Ubuntu, Docker, and clients for Android, macOS, Windows, Linux. Its graphical panel enables management of subscriptions, traffic splitting, and firewalls without configuration files, integrating the sing-box kernel and full Geo data, featuring rule debugging, chain proxy, and direct DNS, suitable for scientific browsing and traffic optimization on LAN devices.

repos.description: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)
repos.summary_zh: 基于Golang开发的极简免费微信消息推送服务，支持Docker一键部署，日均10万次额度，通过微信原生弹窗与声音提醒实现高效通知，适用于个人及团队场景，并提供免费公共推送接口。
repos.summary_en: A minimal and free WeChat message push service built with Golang, featuring one-click Docker deployment, 100k daily pushes, native WeChat pop-up and sound alerts for efficient notifications, suitable for personal and team use with a free public API.

repos.description: Docker版本的E5调用API续订服务：Microsoft 365 E5 Renew X
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供Microsoft 365 E5账号API续订服务的Docker容器化部署方案，支持多种CPU架构，镜像轻量仅225M，可通过一行命令快速部署。具备邮件通知功能，定时检测账号状态并发送报告，适用于学习与个人运维场景，禁止商业使用。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a Docker containerized deployment solution for Microsoft 365 E5 account API renewal services, supporting multiple CPU architectures. The lightweight image (225M) enables quick deployment with a single command. It includes email notification features to periodically check account status and send reports, suitable for learning and personal operations, but commercial use is prohibited.

repos.description: 以 MoonTV v100 版本 / Helios 为后端的 Android TV 客户端，针对遥控器设备优化
repos.summary_zh: Selene-TV 是针对遥控器优化的 Android TV 客户端，基于 Compose for TV 构建。集成 MoonTV 后端，支持双内核播放、多源测速、多平台弹幕及手机扫码遥控，提供沉浸式大屏追剧体验。
repos.summary_en: Selene-TV is an Android TV client designed specifically for D-pad remote controls, integrating seamlessly with the MoonTV and Helios backends. Built using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for TV, it offers dual playback engine support (ExoPlayer/mpv), multi-source aggregation with intelligent speed testing, multi-platform bullet screen merging, and a convenient phone remote control feature. The app provides an immersive, metadata-rich interface with deep navigation optimization and robust caching, delivering a premium, cinema-grade streaming experience for smart TVs and TV boxes.

repos.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。
repos.summary_zh: RSSPush 是一款基于 Docker 的 Web 应用，实时监控 RSS 源内容变化，并自动将最新消息推送到微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道。支持 HTTP 代理、关键词过滤、自动翻译等功能，可结合 RSSHub 使用，适用于个人和团队的信息自动化推送场景。
repos.summary_en: RSSPush is a Docker-based web application that monitors RSS feed changes in real-time and automatically pushes the latest content to dozens of messaging channels such as WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. It supports HTTP proxies, keyword filtering, auto-translation, and can integrate with RSSHub, making it ideal for automated information pushing for individuals and teams.

repos.description: MistRelay MistRelay 是一个基于 Telegram Bot 的高性能 aria2 下载控制、Telegram 频道网盘中继与媒体流分发系统。系统将 HTTP/磁力/种子下载、Telegram 频道无限云存储、多机器人免加频道负载均衡集群、@BotFather 自动化扩容流水线、后台缩略图静默预热引擎、统一缓存生命周期治理中心以及现代毛玻璃 Web 管理中台整合至单个安全加固的 Docker 容器中。                                     官网：https://mistrelay.jiuyue520.com/
repos.summary_zh: MistRelay v3.0 是企业级多租户 Telegram 云盘与边缘流媒体分发中台，整合 Aria2 下载、AI 客服与自动化运维，实现安全隔离与高效分发。
repos.summary_en: MistRelay v3.0 is an enterprise multi-tenant Telegram cloud storage and edge streaming platform, integrating Aria2 downloads, AI service, and automated ops for secure, efficient media distribution.
